description: Compares one metric in the 6 weeks before vs. the 6 weeks after a date, such as the day a medication started. For symptoms compare entries (how often) and avg_severity; for vitals and sleep compare avg_value.

configuration.query: FROM health-timeline | WHERE name == ?metric | EVAL days_from_pivot = DATE_DIFF("day", TO_DATETIME(?pivot), @timestamp) | WHERE days_from_pivot >= -42 AND days_from_pivot < 42 | EVAL period = CASE(days_from_pivot < 0, "before", "after") | STATS entries = COUNT(*), avg_value = ROUND(AVG(value), 1), avg_severity = ROUND(AVG(severity), 1) BY period | SORT period DESC

metric.description: Exact name from signal_list_tracked, e.g. fatigue, resting_hr, sleep_hours

pivot.description: The date to compare around, ISO format, e.g. 2026-07-17
